content.title: Refactor E2E tests to shared worktree approach
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/e2e-refactor.md

Refactor the E2E test suite from per-test git repos to a shared worktree approach in validation/. The spec was authored by library-validator and covers:
- Type A tests (git ops: init, push, pull) — clean git env per test
- Type B tests (CRUD, comments, blockages, etc.) — fast data reset per test
- New helpers: initE2EWorktree, teardownE2EWorktree, resetWorktreeData, setAuthMode
- Remove old helpers: createTestRepo, cleanupTestRepo, createIsolatedDir, cleanupIsolatedDir

Prerequisite (--branch flag) is already implemented. Phases 2-5 of the spec remain.
